description: Hand search of frontier-model system cards, digital-humanities and computational-linguistics venues, shared tasks and benchmark aggregators. The finder is recorded in Hunter, the source in Source.

window.note: no publication window at search time; the recency criterion (after March 2023, with MMLU as documented exception) was applied at screening

notes: 28 of these records carry Source 2 = ASREVIEW: they were in the table before the ASReview screening and were loaded into it as seed (prior relevant) records, so their presence in the pool is not an independent discovery.
EduArt (added 2026-07-03) has no Hunter and no Accept decisions recorded.

reconstructed.method: route from Source/Source 2/Hunter; Added on = date of the first git commit of input/papers.csv containing the row
